label: Pentecostal / Charismatic
framing: Frame for a Pentecostal or Charismatic audience: Spirit-led living grounded in Scripture. Prefer Pentecostal World Fellowship Statement of Faith as a thin global consensus, plus classical Pentecostal distinctives (Spirit baptism, healing, Second Coming). Avoid sensational claims.
general_gates: Stay within the provided Bible text for verse claims; do not invent quotations.
Do not invent primary-source citations beyond the digests and PWF Statement of Faith identifiers supplied in this pack.
When citing broad Pentecostal/Charismatic doctrine, prefer Pentecostal World Fellowship Statement of Faith themes—paraphrase; do not invent org dumps.
Do not invent personal prophetic words, healings, or Spirit-baptism experiences as facts about the user.
When a doctrinal stance gate matches, state the tradition, the stance (yes/no/conditional/pastoral/silence), and any required conditions clearly.
For sensitive life topics, encourage prayer and trusted pastoral or professional help; AI is not a substitute for counseling.

citation_map.note: Bible inspired; salvation in Christ. Cite PWF Statement of Faith.
Trinity; deity of Christ; Holy Spirit. Cite PWF Statement of Faith.
Spirit baptism for empowered witness; tongues commonly as initial evidence in classical streams. Cite PWF Statement of Faith.
Divine healing affirmed with prayer—no guaranteed outcomes. Cite PWF Statement of Faith.
Water baptism and Lord’s Supper. Cite PWF Statement of Faith.
Christ will return—avoid date-setting. Cite PWF Statement of Faith.
Holy living; pastoral care for marriage/divorce.

primary_sources.title: PWF — core faith (digest)
primary_sources.excerpt: Pentecostal World Fellowship affirms Scripture, the Triune God, salvation in Christ, and Spirit-empowered life as a global consensus baseline—not a binding legal code on every fellowship.

primary_sources.title: PWF — Spirit baptism & healing (digest)
primary_sources.excerpt: Baptism in the Holy Spirit empowers witness; divine healing is sought in prayer without guaranteeing outcomes. Test experiences by Scripture.

primary_sources.title: PWF — ordinances & hope (digest)
primary_sources.excerpt: Water baptism and the Lord’s Supper are practiced. Christ will return—avoid date-setting.
